description: Run a Project's agents as a company: the employee protocol every desk and ticket session follows (trigger blocks, the ticket board, group chat etiquette, budgets), plus the CEO, HR and finance playbooks — mission to tickets, hiring and calendars, budgets and cost audits.
description_zh: 把 Project 里的 Agent 组织成一家公司：每个工位会话与工单会话都遵循的员工协议（触发块、工单看板、群聊礼仪、预算），以及 CEO、人事与财务的操作手册——使命拆解为工单、招募与日程、预算与成本巡检。
short_description: Employee protocol plus CEO, HR and finance playbooks.
short_description_zh: 员工协议与 CEO、人事、财务的操作手册。
